definitions.explanation: The kitchen area of a traditional Japanese restaurant where food is prepared. Named after the wooden boards ({板|いた}) used in the workspace.
By extension, refers to the person who works in the kitchen — the chef or cook of a Japanese restaurant.

examples.japanese: {板場|いたば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さばく。
examples.english: To fillet fish in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: {板場|いたば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not enter the kitchen during busy hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板場|いたば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十年|にじゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧だ。
examples.english: The chef at this restaurant is a veteran with twenty years of experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{板場|いたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Despite his youth, he has been entrusted with the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{板場|いたば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下働|したばたら}き⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: During his apprenticeship, he started from the bottom in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板場|いたば}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The chef at that traditional restaurant is very skilled.

notes:
Specifically associated with traditional Japanese cuisine (⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧) and Japanese-style restaurants. Not used for Western-style kitchens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {板場|いたば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand in the kitchen (i.e., to work as a chef)
- {板場|いたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される: to be entrusted with the kitchen
- {板場|いたば}さん: the chef (colloquial, respectful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ / ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧: kitchen — general terms for any kitchen
- ⟦{厨房|ちゅうぼう}→厨房：11940_chuubou⟧: kitchen (professional) — used for restaurant kitchens of any cuisine
- ⟦{板前|いたまえ}→板前：13118_itamae⟧: Japanese cuisine chef — refers specifically to the person, more common than {板場|いたば} in sense 2
- ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧: cook, chef — general term for any professional cook
